title: 16716 - 16716/P0332
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
stepByStepSolution: Torque Knock Sensör Okuma Değerleri 2 (G66) to specifications
Kontrol edin:  Knock Sensör Okuma Değerleri 2 (G66) and Knock Control
technicalNotes: The Knock sensor (piezoelectric sensor) is used to detect abnormal combustion events. Voltage (typically 0-5mV) is generated when the Knock sensor ‘hears/feels’ a range of vibrations. If the voltage is not as expected or is out of range this DTC is usually set.
model: 911, Passat, Golf, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco, Jetta, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, TT, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, Taycan
